narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twelve squared is one four four, so zero point one two squared is zero point one four four.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Each zero point one two has two decimal places, so the answer needs four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The bubble kept too few decimal places, so it is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>To check, count decimal places. Squaring a decimal doubles the number of places.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>For one hundred twenty, the square of ten adds two zeros to one hundred forty four.
